notes.representation: log1p(UMI / total human-gene UMIs * 1e4); predictions must use this space
notes.controls: all A549 24h vehicle cells (both replicates) = permitted controls
notes.taus: tau_q = q-quantile of r(x) over controls, so f_tau(controls) = q
notes.fit_cells: control + train cells only (val/test conditions excluded)
notes.pca: sklearn PCA(50) on unscaled log1p(CP10K) of eval genes
notes.mmd_sigmas: 0.5/1/2 x median pairwise PCA distance of 2000 fit cells
